hypothesis: Target-aligned ensembles may improve held-out probability or point error; equal inclusion of all features is not assumed beneficial.

targets.home_win: HOME_WIN_CONDITIONAL_NON_TIE; final ties omitted from binary scores only

weights: NONNEGATIVE_SUM_TO_ONE; SLSQP; fit separately per target; no test-season adaptation
calibration: SIGMOID_OF_BLEND_LOGIT; nonnegative slope; 2022 only; L2 penalty 0.001 toward slope1/intercept0
source_policy: Official nflverse distribution preferred; stable identities; raw or explicitly derived package-output hashes; actual retrieval times; no publication-time invention.
metric_policy: Separate units, perspective, observed denominators, finality, source cutoff, and availability. No score/market columns in football features. Source model fields retain upstream-vintage flags.
runtime_policy: Explicit candidate only; all required arms and same target/event/cutoff required; missing arms fail instead of silently renormalizing; no current forecast generated by this experiment.
deferred_sources: Pace/drive/role features without compatible lagged historical fit
nflWAR fitted effects without verified IDs/scale/PIT
WNBA RAPM belongs to separate sport and has unresolved source defects
Toto/TabICL/Granite remain separately evaluated candidates, not assumed fitted
